payload.artist_html: L. Ridolfi, A. E. Schrøder, A. Bahrami, M. Yazdi, A. Roa-Varón, G. Marramà, G. Carnevale
payload.credit_html: "A new fossil from the Eocene of Iran provides new insights regarding the evolution of the morphologically bizarre tube-eye fish"
payload.description_html: Parastylephorus anatoides from the Eocene of Babaheydar, Iran. Holotype, IUGM 100897'. A, cranial bones in lateral view. B, interpretative reconstruction. Abbreviations: ang, anguloarticular; bo, basioccipital; clt, cleithrum; co, coracoid; d, dentary; entp, endopterygoid; epo, epioccipital; exo, exoccipital; fr, frontal; h, hyomandibula; l, lachrymal; le, lateral ethmoid; me, mesethmoid; mtp, metapterygoid; mx, maxilla; na, nasal; op, opercle; pa, parietal; pal, palatine; pas, parasphenoid; pcl, postcleithrum; pfr, pectoral fin rays; pmx, premaxilla; pop, preopercle; pro, prootic; pt, posttemporal; pto, pterotic; pts, pterosphenoid; q, quadrate; rar, retroarticular; sc, scapula; scl, supracleithrum; soc, supraoccipital; spo, sphenotic; sym, symplectic; v, vertebra; vom, vomer. Scale bar represents 2 mm.
